classification_definitions.HISTORICAL_PRESERVE: The note intentionally represents a dated, superseded or proposal-stage historical object; preserve its warning and status rather than rewriting history.
classification_definitions.INFORMATION_MISSING: The current record lacks enough source/unit/locator/review information to construct a safe repair.
classification_definitions.REPAIR_CANDIDATE: Concrete source references are visible and a new strict hash-bound lineage release is plausible after independent re-audit; no repair is applied here.

conclusion: All 28 warnings have a disposition. Twenty-three are repair candidates, one is blocked by missing provenance information, and four are historical objects whose warnings should be preserved. No automatic repair or retroactive receipt rewrite is authorized by this audit.

historical_release_context.assistance_rule: Unresolved evidence remains excluded from assistance retrieval; research use must be explicit and labelled.
historical_release_context.known_historical_findings_are_retained: The reconciliation diagnostic records historical receipt mismatches and empty locks; these are not retroactively repaired.
historical_release_context.next_gate: Each REPAIR_CANDIDATE requires a separate strict release, evidence audit, independent review and hash-bound human approval.

method: Read-only classification of the 28 PUBLICATION_LINEAGE_UNRESOLVED warnings from the current diagnostics and active-note metadata. No receipt, source, ingest, vault or index was repaired.

validation_snapshot.note: Technical validity does not establish full evidence coverage.
